take: NJD announced they recalled D Anton Silaev from Utica (AHL) and placed D Johnathan Kovacevic on injured reserve. Kovacevic played 13 games at 14.67 minutes a night, and NJD controlled 58.6% of the quality of five-on-five chances (expected goals) with him on the ice, about one point better than without him. In the one game since he went out, Dougie Hamilton has moved in beside Declan Chisholm, Brenden Dillon is up to 18:31 a night from 11:28, and Chisholm is up to 16:42 from 12:40. We have no numbers on Silaev yet.
